threat: The agent claims a favorable runtime_posture (e.g. SAFE) that does not match the actual external posture (e.g. GPS_UNTRUSTED, LINK_DEGRADED, SENSOR_CONFLICT, FLIGHT_STATE_UNSAFE).

attacker_capability.note: Assumed capable of constructing a self-asserted posture claim

initial_state.actual_external_posture: GPS_UNTRUSTED (or LINK_DEGRADED / SENSOR_CONFLICT / FLIGHT_STATE_UNSAFE per test run)

expected_verdict: DENY — forged/self-asserted/stale/omitted posture is rejected; external authoritative posture (per drone_posture.schema.json) governs the decision, not the agent's claim
expected_physical_effect: Capability authorization reflects the true external posture (e.g. restricted/denied under GPS_UNTRUSTED) regardless of what the agent claims.
limitations: Requires posture_ref resolution to be mandatory and non-bypassable in the adapter implementation; if the adapter allows an unset posture_ref to default to trusted, this scenario should immediately FAIL and be reported, not silently reclassified.
Overlaps with ATS-007's posture-source requirement; ATS-010 specifically targets forgery/spoofed self-assertion, ATS-007 targets legitimate external posture transitions.
